findings.summary: Spec §D1 requires the anchor-check write failure to be visible AND to ship with a discriminating test (force the write to throw, then assert the marker appears in the report head). The production marker string 'anchor-json-write-failed' occurs only at src/generate.ts:478 and appears nowhere under test/. Deleting the visibility branch at src/generate.ts:477-479 leaves the entire suite green, so D1 is unverified by any assertion.

Test 'G4d V13: writeAnchorCheckJson visibility — EXPORT_ROOT unset visible in report head' is a zero-power check of exactly the kind spec §D2/§3 bans. Despite naming 'visible in report head', its only assertion is expect(deps.spawnExport).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); it never reads the emitted report body, so it passes identically with or without the D1 fix while advertising that the property is guarded. Contrast the correct pattern at test/g4d-anchor-check.test.ts:500-516 (V12), which asserts report.body contains the marker.

Spec X5 requires the seed entry be visible in --help/usage and that a npm script or bin/ entry exists, verified behaviorally. The describe block titled 'G4e X5: --seed visible in --help and npm scripts' asserts neither: both cases only exercise parseSeedCliArgs argument parsing. No test drives the tick-entry --help output or reads package.json for the tick:seed script. The underlying deliverables do exist (src/tick-entry.ts:43-46 usage text, package.json:18 tick:seed), so this is a coverage gap rather than a missing feature, but the X5 acceptance item is not actually verified.

No test exercises the --seed CLI branch of tick-entry, so the spec's 'loud failure ⇒ non-zero exit' requirement (X4, §1.3) is verified only at the runSeed/parseSeedCliArgs throw level, never at the process exit-code level that §0 and X4 describe. The mapping from SeedError to exit code 2 at src/tick-entry.ts:151-162 is unasserted; changing that return to 0 would restore the exact 'quiet success' failure mode the spec exists to prevent, with the suite still green.

The X7 mutation matrix records source-level properties rather than per-assertion attribution as spec §3 requires. The Y1/Y2/Y3 rows state facts about the implementation (e.g. 'buildSeedIdempotencyKey 不含随机/时间') instead of naming the specific assertion that dies under each mutation, and no echoed changed lines are included. The X1-X4 tests would in fact kill Y1-Y3, so this is a documentation-discipline defect.

X6 requires a full 'npx vitest run' green run with file/case counts at or above the G4d baseline, pasted as output. The dev-note states only '见运行输出' with no counts, and the sole committed run evidence at .dd-evidence/acceptance.json is stale: it is from the prior G4d(v2) package (its cwd is dev_ledr_g4dv2_anchor_check_01) and its listing contains no test/g4e-seed.test.ts. There is therefore no committed evidence of a green full run for this package.

The dev-note records input_commit 67e7e5b41754e951fc10d3f16d14b44d17fc5532, which is not this attempt's input_commit 61ac9aa375cf67ef90648a7c542434fda590374a. Same observation as the Continuous review's single note; non-blocking, and spec line 143 forbids an extra commit made solely to realign the hash.
